#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a cartoon SVG of an octopus chef at a ramen booth.

Output: ./output/octopus-ramen-chef.svg
Run from the work root:  python3 src/make_octopus_ramen.py
"""
import os
import random
import xml.dom.minidom

W, H = 1200, 800
OUT = os.path.join("output", "octopus-ramen-chef.svg")


def stripes(x0=100, x1=1100, top=148, front=222, slant=16, n=12):
    """Awning stripes + scalloped edge + light bulbs along the edge."""
    w = (x1 - x0) / n
    s = []
    for i in range(n):
        xa = x0 + i * w
        xb = xa + w
        col = "#D62828" if i % 2 == 0 else "#FFF1D6"
        s.append(
            f'<polygon points="{xa:.1f},{top} {xb:.1f},{top} '
            f'{xb + slant:.1f},{front} {xa + slant:.1f},{front}" fill="{col}"/>'
        )
    for i in range(n):  # scallops
        cx = x0 + i * w + w / 2 + slant
        col = "#D62828" if i % 2 == 0 else "#FFF1D6"
        s.append(
            f'<ellipse cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{front}" rx="{w / 2 + 0.6:.1f}" '
            f'ry="20" fill="{col}"/>'
        )
    for i in range(n):  # bulbs on scallop tips
        cx = x0 + i * w + w / 2 + slant
        cy = front + 20
        op = "1;.55;1" if i % 2 == 0 else ".55;1;.55"
        s.append(
            f'<circle cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy}" r="9" fill="#FFE66D" opacity="0.28"/>'
            f'<circle cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy}" r="4.5" fill="#FFE66D">'
            f'<animate attributeName="opacity" values="{op}" dur="1.8s" '
            f'repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>'
        )
    return "\n".join(s)


def stars():
    random.seed(7)
    s = []
    for i in range(80):
        x = random.uniform(0, W)
        y = random.uniform(6, 300)
        r = random.uniform(0.8, 2.2)
        o = round(random.uniform(0.35, 1.0), 2)
        if i % 5 == 0:
            s.append(
                f'<circle cx="{x:.0f}" cy="{y:.0f}" r="{r:.1f}" fill="#FFF">'
                f'<animate attributeName="opacity" values="{o};0.15;{o}" '
                f'dur="{random.uniform(1.5, 3.5):.1f}s" '
                f'repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>'
            )
        else:
            s.append(
                f'<circle cx="{x:.0f}" cy="{y:.0f}" r="{r:.1f}" fill="#FFF" '
                f'opacity="{o}"/>'
            )
    return "\n".join(s)


def arm(path_d, cups):
    """One octopus arm: thick base stroke, lighter highlight, suction cups."""
    c = "\n".join(
        f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="7" fill="#FFD9C7" '
        f'stroke="#D66B7F" stroke-width="2"/>' for x, y in cups
    )
    return (
        f'<path d="{path_d}" fill="none" stroke="#C43D5A" stroke-width="48" '
        f'stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        f'<path d="{path_d}" fill="none" stroke="#E85D75" stroke-width="40" '
        f'stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        f'<path d="{path_d}" fill="none" stroke="#FF8FA0" stroke-width="13" '
        f'stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>\n{c}'
    )


def lantern(cx, top_y, char, delay="0s"):
    cy = top_y + 52
    return f"""
<g>
  <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
    values="-2.5 {cx} 244;2.5 {cx} 244;-2.5 {cx} 244" dur="4.2s"
    begin="{delay}" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  <line x1="{cx}" y1="244" x2="{cx}" y2="{top_y + 6}" stroke="#3A2310"
    stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="62" fill="#FFD166" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="40" ry="50" fill="url(#lanternG)"
    stroke="#B23A3A" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="24" ry="46" fill="none" stroke="#B23A3A"
    stroke-width="2" opacity="0.35"/>
  <ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="10" ry="44" fill="none" stroke="#B23A3A"
    stroke-width="2" opacity="0.3"/>
  <rect x="{cx - 15}" y="{top_y - 2}" width="30" height="12" rx="4"
    fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <rect x="{cx - 15}" y="{cy + 48}" width="30" height="12" rx="4"
    fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <text x="{cx}" y="{cy + 13}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="36"
    font-weight="bold" fill="#D62828"
    font-family="Verdana,'Hiragino Sans','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif">{char}</text>
</g>"""


def bowl_g(cx, rim_y, s=1.0, flip=1, shadow=True, rest_chopsticks=False):
    """Ramen bowl drawn in a translated/scaled group centered on rim."""
    sh = ('<ellipse cx="0" cy="64" rx="70" ry="10" fill="#000" opacity="0.25"/>'
          if shadow else "")
    sticks = ""
    if rest_chopsticks:
        sticks = ('<line x1="-58" y1="-8" x2="58" y2="-16" stroke="#C68A4A" '
                  'stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
                  '<line x1="-58" y1="-1" x2="58" y2="-9" stroke="#A06A35" '
                  'stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
    return f"""
<g transform="translate({cx},{rim_y}) scale({flip * s},{s})">
  {sh}
  <rect x="-20" y="56" width="40" height="12" rx="4" fill="#16697F"/>
  <path d="M-62,0 L-44,56 Q0,66 44,56 L62,0 Z" fill="url(#bowlG)"
    stroke="#16697F" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M-59,10 Q0,22 59,10" stroke="#E63946" stroke-width="3"
    fill="none" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M-40,30 q10,12 20,0 M-12,36 q10,12 20,0 M16,30 q10,12 20,0"
    stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.45"/>
  <rect x="14" y="-38" width="24" height="36" rx="3" fill="#1E4D2B"
    stroke="#12341D" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(8 26 -20)"/>
  <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="62" ry="18" fill="#EAF6F6" stroke="#16697F"
    stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="0" cy="-1" rx="50" ry="13" fill="#C96A28"/>
  <ellipse cx="0" cy="-2" rx="33" ry="8" fill="#E8933F"/>
  <path d="M-38,-2 q7,-7 14,0 t14,0 t14,0 t14,0 t14,0" stroke="#FFE66D"
    stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M-30,5 q7,-6 14,0 t14,0 t14,0 t14,0" stroke="#FFE66D"
    stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="-26" cy="0" r="12" fill="#FFF" stroke="#DDD" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="-26" cy="0" r="6" fill="#F4842B"/>
  <circle cx="-28" cy="-2" r="2" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="2" r="10" fill="#FFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="2" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#F25C78" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="2" r="2.4" fill="#F25C78"/>
  <circle cx="-8" cy="-6" r="3" fill="#7FB069"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="3" r="3" fill="#7FB069"/>
  <circle cx="-2" cy="7" r="3" fill="#5A9E4B"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="-7" r="3" fill="#7FB069"/>
  <circle cx="-14" cy="6" r="3" fill="#5A9E4B"/>
  {sticks}
</g>"""


def steam(x, y, s=1.0, delay=0.0):
    paths = []
    for k, dx in enumerate((-20, 0, 20)):
        b = delay + k * 1.07
        paths.append(f"""
  <path d="M{x + dx},{y} c-9,-14 9,-22 0,-36 c-9,-14 9,-22 0,-36"
    transform="scale(1)" stroke-width="{6 * s}">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
      values="0 10;0 -12" dur="3.2s" begin="{b:.2f}s"
      repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;.55;0" dur="3.2s"
      begin="{b:.2f}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </path>""")
    return ('<g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-linecap="round">'
            + "".join(paths) + "</g>")


def shelf_jars(xs):
    cols = ["#E8A54B", "#7FB069", "#C1666B"]
    s = []
    for i, x in enumerate(xs):
        c = cols[i % 3]
        s.append(f"""
  <rect x="{x}" y="346" width="36" height="52" rx="8" fill="{c}"
    stroke="#3A2310" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.95"/>
  <rect x="{x + 4}" y="350" width="6" height="40" rx="3" fill="#FFF"
    opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="{x - 2}" y="338" width="40" height="10" rx="4" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <rect x="{x + 8}" y="362" width="20" height="16" rx="2" fill="#FFF8E7"
    opacity="0.9"/>""")
    return "\n".join(s)


def sparkle(x, y, r=10, delay="0s"):
    return f"""
<polygon points="{x},{y - r} {x + r * 0.28},{y - r * 0.28} {x + r},{y} "
  fill="none"/>"""  # placeholder replaced below


def build_svg():
    parts = [f"""<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{W}" height="{H}"
  viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" role="img">
<title>Octopus chef serving ramen at a festival booth</title>
<desc>A cheerful purple-red octopus wearing a chef hat cooks ramen with all
eight arms at a cozy illuminated yatai booth on a festival evening.</desc>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="skyG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#14163A"/>
    <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#2B2A6B"/>
    <stop offset="0.68" stop-color="#7A4A8C"/>
    <stop offset="0.82" stop-color="#E8735A"/>
    <stop offset="0.92" stop-color="#F7B267"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="groundG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#262640"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#17172A"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="woodV" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#A06A35"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6B4220"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="woodTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#E0A960"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#B4762F"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="woodDark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7A4E26"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4E3013"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="octoG" cx="0.42" cy="0.32" r="0.85">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FF7D92"/>
    <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#E85D75"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#C43D5A"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="lanternG" cx="0.4" cy="0.35" r="0.9">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF6D8"/>
    <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#FFD166"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F4A259"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="glow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFB35C" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFB35C" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <linearGradient id="bowlG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3AB0CC"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1F7A94"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="vig" cx="0.5" cy="0.48" r="0.75">
    <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#080818" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#080818" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
  </radialGradient>
</defs>
"""]

    # ---- night sky, moon, hills ----
    parts.append(f"""
<rect x="0" y="0" width="{W}" height="734" fill="url(#skyG)"/>
{stars()}
<circle cx="1050" cy="78" r="56" fill="#FFF3B0" opacity="0.25"/>
<circle cx="1050" cy="78" r="40" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
<circle cx="1038" cy="68" r="8" fill="#E8D48B" opacity="0.7"/>
<circle cx="1060" cy="88" r="5" fill="#E8D48B" opacity="0.7"/>
<ellipse cx="180" cy="640" rx="420" ry="180" fill="#23234A"/>
<ellipse cx="1020" cy="650" rx="440" ry="190" fill="#23234A"/>
""")

    # ---- neighbouring stall silhouettes + side string lights ----
    parts.append("""
<rect x="-40" y="400" width="180" height="220" fill="#1F1F3D"/>
<polygon points="-50,400 150,400 100,360 -10,360" fill="#15152B"/>
<circle cx="20" cy="440" r="9" fill="#E63946"/>
<circle cx="60" cy="440" r="9" fill="#E63946"/>
<circle cx="100" cy="440" r="9" fill="#E63946"/>
<rect x="1060" y="400" width="180" height="220" fill="#1F1F3D"/>
<polygon points="1050,400 1250,400 1210,360 1100,360" fill="#15152B"/>
<circle cx="1100" cy="440" r="9" fill="#E63946"/>
<circle cx="1140" cy="440" r="9" fill="#E63946"/>
<circle cx="1180" cy="440" r="9" fill="#E63946"/>
<path d="M0,214 Q80,244 158,226" stroke="#3A3A5E" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
<circle cx="35" cy="228" r="6" fill="#FFE66D"/>
<circle cx="75" cy="235" r="6" fill="#FF9FB0"/>
<circle cx="115" cy="234" r="6" fill="#FFE66D"/>
<path d="M1042,226 Q1120,244 1200,214" stroke="#3A3A5E" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
<circle cx="1085" cy="234" r="6" fill="#FFE66D"/>
<circle cx="1125" cy="235" r="6" fill="#FF9FB0"/>
<circle cx="1165" cy="228" r="6" fill="#FFE66D"/>
""")

    # ---- booth back wall, glow, shelf ----
    parts.append(f"""
<rect x="188" y="252" width="824" height="310" fill="#2E2118"/>
<ellipse cx="600" cy="470" rx="330" ry="200" fill="url(#glow)"/>
<rect x="210" y="398" width="780" height="12" rx="3" fill="#6B4220"/>
<rect x="210" y="398" width="780" height="4" rx="2" fill="#A06A35" opacity="0.7"/>
{shelf_jars([300, 345, 390])}
{shelf_jars([774, 819, 864])}
""")

    # ---- posts ----
    parts.append("""
<rect x="158" y="210" width="30" height="392" fill="url(#woodV)"
  stroke="#4A2E12" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="162" y="214" width="6" height="384" fill="#D8A05E" opacity="0.5"/>
<rect x="1012" y="210" width="30" height="392" fill="url(#woodV)"

<ellipse cx="173" cy="604" rx="26" ry="10" fill="#3A3A5E"/>
<ellipse cx="1027" cy="604" rx="26" ry="10" fill="#3A3A5E"/>
<g transform="rotate(-6 173 420)">
  <rect x="150" y="392" width="46" height="58" rx="3" fill="#FFF8E7"
    stroke="#C68A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="173" y="414" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold"
    fill="#D62828" font-family="Verdana,'Hiragino Sans',sans-serif">おすす</text>
  <text x="173" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="bold"
    fill="#D62828" font-family="Verdana,'Hiragino Sans',sans-serif">め!</text>
  <circle cx="173" cy="443" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#D62828"
    stroke-width="2.5"/>
</g>
""")

    # ---- awning ----
    parts.append(f"""
{stripes()}
<rect x="100" y="240" width="1016" height="10" fill="#000" opacity="0.15"/>
<rect x="92" y="114" width="1032" height="38" rx="9" fill="#7A1F1F"
  stroke="#4A1212" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="608" y="141" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" font-weight="bold"
  letter-spacing="3" fill="#FFD166"
  font-family="Verdana,'Hiragino Sans','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif">\u2605 OCTOPUS RAMEN \u2605 \u305f\u3053\u30e9\u30fc\u30e1\u30f3</text>
""")

    # ---- noren curtains ----
    noren = ['<rect x="220" y="250" width="760" height="10" rx="5" fill="#4A2E12"/>']
    for x0, x1, ch in [(232, 378, "\u30e9"), (384, 530, "\u30fc"),
                       (670, 816, "\u30e1"), (822, 968, "\u30f3")]:
        cx = (x0 + x1) / 2
        noren.append(f"""
<rect x="{x0}" y="260" width="{x1 - x0}" height="88" fill="#1D3557"
  stroke="#0F1E33" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="{cx}" y="326" text-anchor="middle" font-size="62" font-weight="bold"
  fill="#FFFDF5" font-family="'Hiragino Sans','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif">{ch}</text>""")
    parts.append("\n".join(noren))

    # ---- hanging lanterns ----
    parts.append(lantern(205, 285, "\u5473") + lantern(995, 285, "\u9eba", "1.2s"))

    # ---- back arms (ladle, held bowl, towel wave, noodle lift base) ----
    parts.append(arm("M512,470 C445,450 395,415 372,355 C360,325 362,300 378,290",
                     [(470, 460), (430, 433), (400, 393), (382, 352)]))
    parts.append(arm("M505,515 C440,520 390,505 355,480 C330,462 310,455 305,440",
                     [(460, 524), (415, 518), (375, 503), (348, 478)]))
    parts.append(arm("M688,470 C755,450 805,415 828,355 C840,325 838,300 822,290",
                     [(730, 460), (770, 433), (800, 393), (818, 352)]))
    parts.append(arm("M695,515 C740,500 760,470 770,435",
                     [(722, 508), (742, 484), (757, 460)]))

    # ladle in left-upper arm
    parts.append("""
<line x1="378" y1="290" x2="332" y2="332" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="7"
  stroke-linecap="round"/>
<ellipse cx="322" cy="340" rx="22" ry="13" fill="#9AA5B1" stroke="#5A6470"
  stroke-width="3"/>
<ellipse cx="322" cy="338" rx="14" ry="7.5" fill="#E8933F"/>
<path d="M322,353 q-3,8 3,12" stroke="#E8933F" stroke-width="4" fill="none"
  stroke-linecap="round"/>
""")

    # waving towel in right-upper arm + motion arcs
    parts.append("""
<path d="M788,278 q-12,22 0,44 M773,270 q-16,30 0,60" stroke="#FFF"
  stroke-width="4" fill="none" opacity="0.55" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<g>
  <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
    values="-6 822 290;6 822 290;-6 822 290" dur="2.4s"
    repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  <polygon points="814,292 856,302 848,356 808,344" fill="#F8F8F8"
    stroke="#D0D0D0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="811" y1="318" x2="852" y2="328" stroke="#2A9DB8" stroke-width="5"/>
  <line x1="809" y1="330" x2="850" y2="340" stroke="#2A9DB8" stroke-width="5"/>
</g>
""")

    # held ramen bowl in left-mid arm
    parts.append(bowl_g(296, 392, s=0.82, flip=1, shadow=False,
                        rest_chopsticks=True))

    # ---- octopus head, face, hat, scarf ----
    parts.append("""
<ellipse cx="600" cy="445" rx="125" ry="115" fill="url(#octoG)"
  stroke="#A93252" stroke-width="4"/>
<circle cx="508" cy="400" r="11" fill="#C43D5A" opacity="0.45"/>
<circle cx="692" cy="400" r="11" fill="#C43D5A" opacity="0.45"/>
<circle cx="545" cy="348" r="7" fill="#C43D5A" opacity="0.45"/>
<circle cx="655" cy="348" r="7" fill="#C43D5A" opacity="0.45"/>
<ellipse cx="548" cy="372" rx="28" ry="15" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.35"
  transform="rotate(-18 548 372)"/>
<path d="M524,398 q30,-14 62,-4" stroke="#7A2A3A" stroke-width="6" fill="none"
  stroke-linecap="round"/>
